audit.expected: Rogues use daggers, cloaks and leather armor, and unlock at Archer level 5. Tiered cloaks grant timed invisibility; Planewalker also teleports. Each item has its own mana cost, cooldown and bonuses. Original stats and growth are defined in the reference client.
unknowns: When do actions break invisibility or cause enemies to retarget?
Was Planewalker obtainable in 123.5.1, and how was it acquired?

audit.expected: Archers use bows, quivers and leather armor, and unlock at Priest level 5. T0–T2 quivers Slow; T3–T6 Paralyze. Quiver of Thunder Dazes instead. Each quiver has its own projectile, mana cost and bonuses.
unknowns: Was Quiver of Thunder obtainable in 123.5.1?
Original projectile hitboxes and multi-hit rules.

audit.expected: Wizards use staves, spells and robes, with no class prerequisite. Tiered spells create bullet novas. The original Wisdom cap is 60; spell damage includes the build 123.3 changes. Whether Penetrating Blast was obtainable remains unresolved.

unknowns: Which conditions does Purification remove, in what order, and how does Sick affect healing and eligible players?

unknowns: How overlapping buffs refresh and which players are included at an aura’s boundary.
Original acquisition of each helm.

Server PR334 (009109ea) adds complete engineering reconstructions for Worlds 1, 2 and 3, alongside the three FSOD entries. Revision-bound prepared native smoke evidence is linked in that PR. Original identity, hidden fields, registration, provenance and rights remain unverified; historical and gameplay acceptance are unchanged. Worlds 4 through 13 remain incomplete.

Server PR340 rounds sharp road bends in the three FSOD baseline layouts at import. It restores vacated cells from nearby biome ground and refuses changes to road connectivity, loops, river crossings, water, beach, mountains, set-piece floors or region markers. This moves private-server geometry toward mapgen-style splines; it is not recovered road data, and the World 1 to 3 reconstructions are untouched: https://github.com/OpenRotMG/Open-RotMG-Server/pull/340
unknowns: Original terrain and population inventory, placement, biome thresholds and map dimensions.

checks.acceptance: Clear groups near and far from players and compare recovery. Check shared budgets, no spawn on players, and that finite heroes are not resurrected by ordinary refill.

checks.name: Encounters across actual terrain
checks.expected: Walking and flying families must traverse their real habitat with identity-specific obstacle rules.
checks.acceptance: Lure enemies across roads and biome edges and around trees, walls and water. Check approach/retreat, stuck movement and unintended habitat fences.

checks.name: Pursuit, target loss and obstacles

checks.acceptance: Exercise entry/exit from sight, invisible/paused/dead targets, corners, reacquisition and owner loss. Do not impose one universal historical radius.
